text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Thank you for giving me time off.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've been practicing archery.
Thanks to that, my mind is completely cleared.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Even on my days off, I just thought...
I'd like to keep my posture and mindset in good shape.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: The posture when drawing a bow, the way you regulate your breathing... It naturally straightens you up. Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every single way she spent her days off
was properly connected to her future—
that was just the kind of girl Lucky Lilac was.
